game.desc: Unlike the first two episodes on Xbox 360, the first-person shooter Call of Juarez: The Cartel takes place in the present day. Based on cooperation between the three main heroes, the game invites us to confront a particularly violent Mexican cartel. We'll have to make the most of each character's specificities to clean up Los Angeles and Juarez.
